e030adce-d3d6-4638-b92a-11f6ff7fb67f@ufc.why: The main event pits two ranked lightweights, Renato Moicano (#12) against Tom Nolan (#14), with the winner moving closer to a title shot. The co-feature has Yana Santos (#6) meeting Luana Santos (#7) in a ranked women's bantamweight clash that also affects the title picture. On the undercard, Mickey Gall returns from a four fight losing streak and a medical withdrawal to debut at middleweight against Zachary Reese, who is also trying to snap his own skid.
e030adce-d3d6-4638-b92a-11f6ff7fb67f@ufc.know: In the UFC, numbered rankings run from the champion down through #1 to #15 in each division; wins over ranked opponents help fighters climb toward a title shot. A Fight Night card has no championship bout, but it is often where prospects and veterans fighting to save their roster spot make their mark, as with Gall's weight class move after injury setbacks.
